newsitem.title: USA: North Coast settles Lomak litigation.
newsitem.headline: North Coast settles Lomak litigation.

text.p: North Coast Energy Inc said Tuesday that it and Lomak Petroleum Inc have settled their litigation over the control of North Coast.
Under the settlement North Coast has expanded its board from six to nine members, adding three Lomak representatives to North Coast's prior six, North Coast said.
Further, North Coast President Garry Regan has been elected chairman of the Board, the company said. Charles Lombardy Jr will remain chief executive.
The litigation arose after Lomak bought about 47 percent of North Coast's common stock and sought to elect directors not nominated by North Coast.
North Coast said the Lomak representatives added to its board are John Pinkerton, C. Rand Michaels and Steven Grose.
North Coast is an independent oil and gas exploration and production company that operates mainly in the Appalachian Basin.
